subsets.name: ASAL counties eligible for county-level Resilience & Environment tab
subsets.source_name: National Drought Management Authority — 2022 Long Rains Season Assessment
subsets.source_note: NDMA's assessment covers 23 ASAL counties. Nyeri is explicitly qualified as northern Nyeri (Kieni sub-county), so this county-level tab subset conservatively includes the 22 counties named without a sub-county qualifier. Nyeri/Kieni is recorded separately below and does not trigger a county-wide tab.

partial_memberships.reason: NDMA assessment names northern Nyeri (Kieni), not Nyeri County as a whole.
